Container.Name: Wardarr
Container.Overview: Self-hosted control center for the *arr stack, download clients, media servers and Seerr. Groups issues by cause, cleans the download queue carefully, hunts for missing titles at a calm pace and lets everyone request something to watch.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database and generated encryption key. Include it in your backups.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Address you open Wardarr at, for links in notifications. Optional.

Config.Name: Trust reverse proxy
Config.Description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers. Turn on behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: 32-byte key (base64 or hex) that encrypts stored credentials. Generated into the appdata folder when empty.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for schedules and logs.
